A.session_notes: HOLD EVERYTHING. 08-09 was your cleanest session since June - every set hit target, no mid-set collapse, RPE down to 9. Nothing has earned a jump yet, so repeat it and aim for RPE 8 this time. Bench stays at 70: it was the only lift that stayed at RPE 10 through the deload, so it does not go back to 72.5 until it feels like an 8. DATA FIX: last time your wrist curl logged as 24-25kg, identical to the reverse curl above it - that was a copy error. It should be 60kg. Log it correctly today.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press
exercises.notes: Hold 70kg. Full 2 min rest - take all of it. Target RPE 8, not 10.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Hold 17.5kg. You finally got 3 clean 10s here after weeks of 12/10/8. Repeat it before adding reps.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45
exercises.notes: Hold 145kg x 10. Partial ROM, knee-friendly depth. Do not chase depth.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Hold 7.5kg. Accessory - this should feel like RPE 7-8. If it is a 9 again, drop to 2 sets rather than dropping the weight.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.notes: Hold 75kg x 15. Kneeling, facing the stack. Crunch with the abs, not the hips.

exercises.name: Cable Reverse Curl (superset A)
exercises.notes: 24kg - this is your calibrated number from last time (you started 25 and settled at 24 for RPE 8). Straight into the wrist curl, no rest.

exercises.name: Cable Wrist Curl (superset B)
exercises.notes: 60kg - NOT 24. Last session logged this wrong by copying the line above. 60kg is your real number from 07-20. 60s rest after the pair.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly (drop set)
exercises.notes: One triple-drop, no rest: 45kg to failure -> 35kg -> 26kg. Start moved to 45 because that is what you actually use. RPE 10 here is by design.

B.session_notes: The deload is working, so Day B gets the same treatment. RDL drops 75 -> 70 because you collapsed 8/6/5 at RPE 10 last time - that is the exact pattern the Day A deload fixed. Face Pull drops to 40 because it is prehab, not a lift. Seated Row is the ONLY thing going up (it hit 3x12 at RPE 8, textbook earned). Target RPE 8 everywhere except the final drop set. OPEN QUESTION: Box Situp has logged empty twice while you did cable crunches instead - pick one and tell me so the plan matches reality.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: DOWN to 70kg from 75. LOWER BACK: highest-risk lift on the board for you. Stop the rep when the back rounds, not when the hamstrings give out.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip
exercises.notes: Hold 4x5 bodyweight. Worth noting: same reps at a lighter bodyweight is a real strength gain the log does not show as a number.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: UP to 22.5kg. The only lift going up today - 3x12 at RPE 8 earned it outright.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Curl
exercises.notes: Hold 30kg, target 10. Preacher drop set still to come - leave something in the tank.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: DOWN to 40kg. This is shoulder prehab - RPE 9 on a face pull misses the point. High elbows, pull to the forehead, no leaning back.

exercises.name: Box Situp
exercises.notes: 3x12 bodyweight. LOWER BACK: controlled extension over the box, no ballistic hyperextension - this is what got Ab Wheel removed.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: One triple-drop, no rest: 35kg to failure -> 30kg -> 25kg. RPE 10 belongs here and nowhere else today.

C.session_notes: First Day C since 07-26 - the 08-03 one was never run (vacation), so these numbers come off 07-26. Box Squat is the only lift going up: 3x10 at RPE 7 was the cleanest data in that session. Everything else holds with rep targets at 10, because 07-26 was RPE 10 on incline press, cable row and lat pulldown. TIME LEVER: this day has run 58 min twice. If you are past 40 min when you reach Bulgarian Split Squat, do 2 sets instead of 3.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: Hold 22.5kg, target 10. Last time the 22.5 broke you: 12/9/8 and you dropped to 20 on set 3. Own it at 10 first.

exercises.name: Box Squat
exercises.notes: UP to 52.5kg. 3x10 at RPE 7 earned this, and you already did 52.5 on 07-03. KNEE: high box, controlled depth, no bouncing off the box.

exercises.name: Cable Row
exercises.notes: Hold 50kg, reps 12 -> 10. You completed 3x12 but at RPE 10 - completed and maxed are not the same thing.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Hold 10kg x 10 per leg. KNEE: front shin vertical, weight through the front heel, stop short of full flexion on the back knee. Cut to 2 sets if you are behind on time.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Hold 40kg, reps 12 -> 10. Read the trend: 45kg at RPE 9 on 07-03, then 40kg still at RPE 10 on 07-26. Lighter and harder is a recovery signal, not a lat problem.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Hold 12.5kg x 10. This was RPE 8 last time - correct zone for an accessory, leave it alone.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: One triple-drop, no rest: 35kg to failure -> 30kg -> 25kg. Same finisher as Day B.
